short: The share of customers who buy more than once.
seoTitle: Repeat Rate — Meaning, Formula and Example
metaDescription: Repeat rate is the percentage of customers who make more than one purchase in a period. It is the simplest measure of whether a business earns a second visit.
definition: Repeat rate is the percentage of customers who make more than one purchase in a period. It is the simplest measure of whether a business earns a second visit.
bodyHtml:
Why Repeat Rate matters

Repeat customers cost nothing to acquire and typically spend more. A business with a low repeat rate is on an acquisition treadmill, buying every sale it makes.

Repeat Rate formula

Repeat rate % = Customers with more than one purchase ÷ Total customers × 100

Measure over a window that matches your natural purchase cycle.

How Repeat Rate works in practice

Measuring it requires identifying customers, usually by phone number at billing. Once that exists, the split between first-time and returning revenue becomes the most useful chart on the dashboard.

faq.question: How do I track repeat customers without an app?
faq.answer: Capture the phone number at billing. That single field enables repeat rate, retention and win-back campaigns.

faq.question: What is a good repeat rate?
faq.answer: It depends on the category — a daily cafe should be far higher than a furniture shop. Track your own trend.
